tasks.short: Explain educational programmes to public audiences

steps.what: Select current programme objectives and prepare public presentation materials
Address public audiences, explain objectives and respond to concerns to elicit support

tasks.design: Reuse approved presentation sections through native templates in {DOCS}. The coordinator selects and checks current facts, then delivers the explanation and handles public concerns in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layout and copying of established programme information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and linked document sections can reduce assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Support depends on trust, local priorities and candid answers.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a concern that the prepared explanation has not addressed.
tasks.altitude: Less presentation assembly with unchanged public speaking responsibility.

reach.task: Respond to recurring public concerns about programme priorities
reach.learn: Separate audience concerns from evidence of programme effectiveness

evidence.claim: Native presentation templates can reduce assembly of repeated approved content; this is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes presentation preparation and public delivery, excluding programme objective-setting and subsequent fundraising.

Programme leadership produces approved objectives and public facts through its unchanged existing process. Coordinator selects source version, event date, audience and relevant sections in s1; capture and factual review remain within its 60% time. Missing or stale facts require manual confirmation before use.
Test native document templates before custom code. No generated claims or public promises and no saving from the 80% public interaction or software runtime.
research_questions: Does section reuse save preparation after checking currency and audience fit?

already_counted.description: Select source sections and check public facts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92; gross 8 minus upkeep 2 gives net 6. High assumes recurring content; low assumes bespoke audience preparation consumes the assembly gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research and recommend curricula and instructional methods

steps.what: Research relevant curricula, methods and materials against the school brief
Prepare evidence comparison with source limitations and competing findings

loop.purpose: Draft a source-grounded comparison of instructional evidence
loop.input: Selected source set and coordinator evaluation questions
loop.output: Comparison with passage references, populations, findings and limitations
loop.check: Coordinator checks original passages, study limits, conflicting findings and whether each claim transfers to the school context
loop.stop: One comparison and one correction; unsupported sections are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates organise headings but do not interpret differences in study findings and limitations

steps.what: Evaluate educational fit, feasibility and trade-offs with school stakeholders
Prepare recommendations with rationale and remaining uncertainties

tasks.design: Use native source search in {DOCS} first, then a bounded model step to draft the evidence comparison from the coordinator's selected publications. The coordinator verifies meaning, evaluates local fit with stakeholders and writes the recommendation; adoption stays with the authorised school decision-makers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing free-text evidence and recording limitations takes repeated reading and drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can organise selected passages for explicit verification.
tasks.still_hard: Research quality and local transfer cannot be settled by citation counts.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an attractive recommendation whose evidence does not fit the learners or setting.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison drafting with unchanged responsibility for educational advice.

reach.task: Plan a limited trial of a curriculum option

evidence.claim: Source-grounded drafting can assist an evidence comparison, but study interpretation and local recommendations require review; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary starts with an existing school brief and ends with advice, excluding adoption decisions, teaching and learner-level assessment.

Coordinator selects accessible source text, version, passage references and evaluation questions in s1; all its research time remains. The draft uses only that set. Missing source text or conflicting evidence is labelled unresolved and handled manually in s2 or s3.
Native search and comparison templates are tested before model drafting. No pupil personal data or automated learning-outcome judgement is introduced; software runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Time spent on comparison versus evaluation
research_questions: Does checked comparison drafting save time while preserving contrary evidence and study limits?

already_counted.description: Verify source meaning, limitations and unsupported comparisons

incremental.description: Maintain source restrictions and review drafting errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 minus upkeep 3 gives net 7. High assumes useful comparisons from accessible sources; low assumes source errors require manual rewriting. Research, evaluation and recommendation time stay intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare grant proposals, programme budgets and policies

steps.what: Gather grant requirements, programme goals, policy constraints and budget inputs
Calculate budget totals, funding shares and required budget schedules
Draft grant proposals, programme policies and goals from the checked brief

loop.purpose: Draft programme documents without inventing commitments
loop.input: Checked preparation brief, required headings and draft budget
loop.output: Draft sections with references to supplied facts and explicit gaps
loop.check: Coordinator checks eligibility wording, budget consistency, realistic goals, policy meaning and all proposed commitments against the brief
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual drafting for unresolved sections
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates supply structure but cannot phrase a programme rationale from varied source material

steps.what: Check proposal and policy accuracy and hand documents to authorised decision-makers

tasks.design: Use checked {SPREADSHEET} budget formulas and native {DOCS} templates before adding a bounded narrative draft. The coordinator verifies the proposal, policy meaning and goals; authorised leaders retain budget commitment, policy adoption and grant submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated budget arithmetic and narrative preparation across required headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Formula reuse and source-grounded drafting can reduce preparation without making commitments.
tasks.still_hard: Eligibility, realistic costs and policy trade-offs need organisational decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Identify a persuasive promise that the programme cannot responsibly deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly with unchanged authority to advise rather than commit funds.

reach.task: Check grant cost eligibility and funding assumptions
reach.learn: Eligible costs, co-funding and budget version control

evidence.claim: Templates, checked formulas and bounded narrative drafting can assist grant and policy preparation; no automatic submission or measured saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator preparation, excluding finance's existing estimates, leadership approval and external submission. Those roles retain their work and are not credited as savings.

Coordinator produces a checked brief in s1 with call version, required headings, eligibility constraints and agreed goals; its full time remains. Finance supplies existing estimates through its unchanged process. Coordinator captures quantity, unit cost, currency, period and funding rule in the budget table in s1. Missing figures remain unresolved and are checked manually, never generated.

Native templates and formulas are tested first. Models draft only where source confidentiality and funder rules permit; otherwise use manual drafting. No new policy or expenditure is enacted by the solution.
unknowns: Funder restrictions and confidential source access
Budget formula coverage and final approval ownership
research_questions: Does checked drafting save preparation time without adding unsupported promises or budget inconsistencies?

already_counted.description: Review budget arithmetic and rule exceptions
Check narrative meaning and unsupported commitments

incremental.description: Maintain templates, budget checks and drafting constraints

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=73.5; gross 26.5 less upkeep 4 gives net 22.5. High assumes reusable schedules and useful drafts; low assumes unusual funder requirements consume preparation gains. Final checking retains 20 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and approve education policy guidance

steps.what: Identify applicable educational policies and gather current source versions
Prepare manuals, guidelines and reports from the policy source set

loop.purpose: Draft readable guidance from supplied education policy sources
loop.input: Verified current policy texts and distribution brief
loop.output: Draft guidance with passage references and unresolved questions
loop.check: Coordinator checks scope, exceptions, mandatory versus advisory wording and whether every instruction follows the source
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual wording for unresolved sections
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cannot reliably restate varied policy provisions while preserving their meaning

steps.what: Check and approve the exact guidance version for distribution

tasks.design: Start with native {DOCS} templates and version control, then use a bounded source-grounded draft where wording varies. The coordinator checks policy meaning and approves the exact guidance version; publication remains with the existing communications process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated writing to turn official policy text into usable guidance.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafts can propose wording with passage references for verification.
tasks.still_hard: Jurisdiction, exceptions and binding obligations must not be flattened into general advice.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a simple-sounding instruction that would misstate the policy.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft work; policy interpretation and approval responsibility remain.

reach.task: Explain how a policy change affects local practice
reach.learn: Distinguish mandatory provisions from implementation choices

evidence.claim: Source-grounded drafting can assist policy guidance with human meaning checks; the scenario does not establish legal accuracy or measured savings.

assumptions: Translate the US state and school-district wording to relevant national or regional education authorities and school networks. Boundary ends with approval for distribution, excluding policy-making and actual publication.

Coordinator produces the verified source set in s1 with jurisdiction, effective date, version, applicable audience and source text; all capture and verification time remains. Unknown applicability or missing current text stops drafting and requires manual clarification.

Test native templates and version control first. Approval assumes the coordinator has the delegated authority; otherwise the existing authorised approver retains its separate work with no claimed saving. No personal pupil data is needed.
unknowns: Frequency of policy changes and source quality
research_questions: Do checked drafts preserve exceptions and mandatory wording while reducing preparation time?

already_counted.description: Check draft meaning, references and unsupported instructions

incremental.description: Maintain drafting constraints and template revisions

approvals.approved_version: Exact guidance document revision, source versions, jurisdiction, effective date and distribution audience; any edit invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80; gross 20 minus upkeep 3 gives net 17. High assumes useful source-grounded first drafts; low assumes complex exceptions require full rewriting. Source verification and approval retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The coordinator spends less time on first drafts and arithmetic while retaining educational and policy judgement.
reach: Work with finance on grant assumptions and school leaders on evidence-based programme trials
role.ambitious_version: Produce clearer educational advice with traceable sources and realistic programme commitments.
